versions.changelog: Invocation hardening: untrusted URLs are now passed only as a single argv element through a shell-free process API; shell interpolation and command-string evaluation are explicitly forbidden, while the pre-provisioned runtime and reproducible wheel integrity contract remain unchanged.

Agent-boundary hardening: the Skill no longer installs, downloads, upgrades, or modifies runtime software; ShareXtract v0.23.3 must be provisioned by the environment/operator, while the Skill records the expected runtime version and reproducible wheel SHA-256 for verification.

Supply-chain hardening: install the dependency-minimal core runtime from the reproducible v0.23.2 wheel pinned by SHA-256; publish SHA256SUMS and GitHub provenance attestation; retain the thin Skill source bundle and public-only guardrails.

Security hardening: pin the canonical runtime to the exact immutable v0.23.1 release commit; retain the 5-file thin Skill bundle; include SSRF/browser/prompt-injection guardrails from the upstream security patch.
